items.title: North American robot orders climb 24.8% in Q3 of 2026, says A3
items.summary: Robot demand from automotive component manufacturers nearly doubled in Q3, as other sectors posted strong gains, reported A3. The post North American robot orders climb 24.8% in Q3 of 2026, says A3 appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: A3 称 2026 年第三季度北美机器人订单增长 24.8%
items.summary_zh: 据 A3 报道，随着其他行业的强劲增长，汽车零部件制造商的机器人需求在第三季度几乎翻了一番。据《机器人报告》报道，A3 首次出现在 2026 年第三季度，北美地区的机器人订单量增长了 24.8%。

items.title: What Symbotic’s Walmart growth teaches robotics startups about anchor customers
items.summary: Symbotic’s growth with Walmart shows how an anchor customer can fund a robotics startup’s scale while creating risks around customer concentration, contractual restrictions and the challenge of building a diversified, repeatable business. The post What Symbotic’s Walmart growth teaches robotics startups about anchor customers appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Symbotic 的沃尔玛增长让机器人初创公司了解了哪些重要客户
items.summary_zh: Symbotic 与沃尔玛的合作展示了主力客户如何为机器人初创公司的规模提供资金，同时在客户集中度、合同限制以及建立多元化、可重复业务的挑战方面带来风险。这篇文章《Symbotic 的沃尔玛增长向机器人初创公司传授了关于主力客户的知识》一文首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title_zh: Warp Sciences 悄然崛起，将机器人技术应用于药物研究

items.title: WorldOracle Tests Whether World Models Can Reliably Predict Real-World Executions
items.summary: In one case showcased by WorldOracle, a robot's grasp missed, yet the world model predicted that the robot had successfully picked up the fruit. The post WorldOracle Tests Whether World Models Can Reliably Predict Real-World Executions appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: WorldOracle 测试世界模型是否可以可靠地预测现实世界的执行
items.summary_zh: 在 WorldOracle 展示的一个案例中，机器人未能抓住水果，但世界模型预测机器人已成功拿起水果。 WorldOracle 测试世界模型是否能够可靠地预测现实世界执行的帖子首先出现在机器人报告上。
